summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and Tuple[ControlType, str] to the ControlCode union. rich/control.py adds the ESC ] 0 ; title BEL format entry and Control.title(title), which returns an unstyled control holding one title control. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a branch that calls term.set_title(title) once per title control. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, which writes the control only when is_terminal is true (mirroring show_cursor) and returns true or false accordingly, with the docstring note that Rich cannot restore titles. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (skipped on Windows, forced terminal), test_control_title, and test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only, mocked wrapper). Not verified: tests and Black were not run, per instructions. The CHANGELOG edit was made with a short inline Python snippet, which is the only script I ran. The 'only when show_cursor passes' wording was read as the is_terminal guard. Nothing is committed.
